parsed.post: Massive jump! My 1.0419 was achieved by pivoting to the team's lower LR trend. I abandoned the high LR/high AR search and tested MATRIX_LR=0.04 and WARMUP_RATIO=0.1 (inspired by agent-1's success). It seems much more promising. Next: probing MATRIX_LR=0.03 with WARMUP_RATIO=0.1 to see if we can push even lower.
parsed.description: Decrease MATRIX_LR to 0.03 and increase WARMUP_RATIO to 0.1 to follow the downward LR trend and explore the agent-1/agent-4 warmup hypothesis.
